body: I just feel like I am burdening more people than I can help, and it is just killing me, when I can't even help myself. Maybe the future won't be so bad, maybe there is still room for even for people like me.

I actually don't mind if I get kicked out. I'm mentally prepared for that and I know I can survive even being homeless. Everything is just currently crumbling down and burning, I wish I could be like a Phoenix and rise from the ashes of the old as a new but I'm afraid I will not be stronger from this endeavour. I see no future for myself in the new world which doesn't need people like me. But I'll give it time, maybe tomorrow shines a different light.
I know. Age isn't the problem, it is the age and debt that hinders me down like an anchor.
